public.text: The criteria distinguish public governance from lifecycle governance but do not explicitly require sustainable financing, an operating model, service ownership, or supplier-exit arrangements.
public.suggestedRevision: Add criteria requiring accountable service ownership, a sustainable operating model, recurrent financing, support arrangements, data and configuration portability, continuity planning, and supplier transition provisions.
